written.title: New GTA 6 Gameplay Revealed Inside South Park Confirms Dog Poop Is A Weapon - Kotaku
written.description: What GamesRadar+, Kotaku, Pure Xbox and Push Square reported: "New GTA 6 Gameplay Revealed Inside South Park Confirms Dog Poop Is A Weapon - Kotaku".
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Grand Theft Auto VI, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## GamesRadar+, 29 October 2026

[South Park breaks the news that GTA 6 lets you throw dog poop, even gets a Grand Theft Auto icon to announce it](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/south-park-breaks-the-news-that-gta-6-lets-you-throw-dog-poop-even-gets-a-grand-theft-auto-icon-to-announce-it/)

The outlet's own summary:

> It's not just a funny gameplay clip, but a neat nod to GTA 5's marketing

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Enter protagonist Jason, who then throws something at the pedestrian, picks up the dog poop himself, and hits them around the face with it as they react in horror.

## Kotaku, 29 October 2026

[New GTA 6 Gameplay Revealed Inside South Park Confirms Dog Poop Is A Weapon - Kotaku](https://kotaku.com/grand-theft-auto-6-south-park-america-dog-poop-video-2000750987)

The outlet's own summary:

> Jason is about make this innocent man’s day a little crappier

> Your horses could poop in Red Dead Redemption 2 , so it’s not too surprising that dogs in Vice City might also have to relieve themselves.

## Pure Xbox, 29 October 2026

[New GTA 6 'Dog Poop' Gameplay, Images, And Extra Info To Hype You Up](https://www.purexbox.com/news/2026/10/new-gta-6-dog-poop-gameplay-images-and-extra-info-to-hype-you-up)

The outlet's own summary:

> South Park has the latest GTA 6 'poop-scoop'

> 1 11 dskatter 1 hour ago @cronogold Yeah, I have zero interest in playing the game myself, but I really want concrete evidence that it “runs best” on PS5.

## Push Square, 29 October 2026

[New GTA 6 Gameplay, Screenshots, Details Revealed as PS5 Launch Nears](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/10/new-gta-6-gameplay-screenshots-details-revealed-as-ps5-launch-nears)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 briefly appears in South Park

> You have probably already seen enough to know whether you are playing it or not (and we have got details on the GTA 6 release times and preload date ), but for anyone still on the fence, Rockstar has even more gameplay, screenshots, and gameplay details to entice.

> 6 4 ShadowRJ 1 hour ago With Phantom Blade Zero out today, we are now firmly in GTA month.

> 8 Review Phantom Blade Zero (PS5) - One of the Generation's Greatest Action Exper...

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
